summary.en: Local LLM inference platform with a prebuilt Windows ARM64 zip, measured by its author on an RTX Spark (N1X) laptop.
summary.zh-TW: 本機 LLM 推論平台，提供預先編譯的 Windows ARM64 壓縮檔，作者在 RTX Spark（N1X）筆電上實測。

caveats.en: All measurements come from one laptop and are self-reported by the author; no independent verification.
caveats.zh-TW: 所有測量皆來自同一台筆電，由作者自行回報，未經獨立驗證。

caveats.en: Executables are not code-signed; some models are unavailable on ARM64.
caveats.zh-TW: 執行檔未經程式碼簽署；部分模型在 ARM64 上無法使用。

evidence.title: Emerald README: emerald-v0.2.0-windows-arm64.zip, tested on RTX Spark N1X
